about: What changed in each reworked deck, shown in the Card Library (Sprint 8, round two). Words for the trial's eleventh version (v0.11; Sprint 9 round two: cards reworked from the lead's play of v0.9, deck lists as in v0.9), each line checked against the trial cards and decks files. Each deck: a title, two lines of identity, a short list of changes; about 170 words a deck at most, plain words. Lines that begin "New:" changed since the page of 27 November (v0.9).
heading: What changed
intro: The four decks have been reworked so each plays its own way, and no pairing has a handicap. Lines that begin "New:" changed since the page of 27 November. Pick a deck.

identity: The attacker. It closes fast and breaks the line: its armor readies after a kill, and a won fight drives the enemy back.
A prepared defense or a cut Supply line stops it. BREAKTHROUGH is its tool against the first, RED BALL against the second.
changes: One RED BALL starts in the Initial Entry. BREAKTHROUGH is Generation III, so it stays in the Main Force: an Initial Entry holds Generation I only. 2 copies, not 3.
BREAKTHROUGH ignores RIPOSTE as well as OBSTACLE for the round.
ROUGH RIDER scouts: ZONE RECONNAISSANCE (reveal 1 Hidden enemy card, gain 2 ISR) replaces CROSS-CUE.
WARLORD's HUNTER-KILLER readies when it destroys an enemy Frontline card, once per round.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
REAVERS cost 2. FLYSWATTER moves to the Main Force.
REDLEG's FIRE SUPPORT now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
No balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The defender. A Close attack on its line costs the attacker, and COUNTERATTACK hits back in Contact.
It wins late, on points, by outlasting the attack on its own line. It has no quick win of its own.
changes: The Initial Entry is Generation I only. BACKTRACK and one STEEL RAIN start there; DRUMFIRE and SUNLANCE wait in the Main Force.
SHIELDWALL and BATTLE POSITION move to the Main Force. BATTLE POSITION and DCO now print how long they last.
BACKTRACK joins the deck: cannon artillery with a counterfire radar. FIRE SUPPORT 2, and COUNTERFIRE answers an enemy Fires attack.
TRENCHER prints two lines, DIG IN and RIPOSTE 1. Its COVER 1 is gone.
RIPOSTE 1 on TRENCHER and REDOUBT: a unit that makes a Close attack on your Frontline takes 1 damage. Only your highest RIPOSTE counts.
COUNTERATTACK costs 1, not 2, and needs only Contact.
WATCHTOWER, an observation post: SCAN gains 2 ISR. 1 copy.
REDOUBT's COVER is 1. BREAKWATER costs 8; its RIPOSTE action is renamed BREAK THE ASSAULT.
DEFENSIVE CYBERSPACE OPERATIONS is now DCO. LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1.
In: FENCE, a second TRENCHER. Out: FLYSWATTER, DEFENSE IN DEPTH, one MYRMIDON, one REDLEG, one DCO.
No balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The information deck of a hybrid force, now with a card of its own in every class. It takes the ISR lead and makes the enemy pay for trailing.
Its jammers exhaust enemy cards; its rockets and irregulars strike them. It takes little ground and wins by draining Homefront.
changes: New: RELAY's RETRANSMIT: gain 1 ISR and you may advance 1 of your Mission Track cards by 1; from space 1 it reaches H-Hour and resolves now.
New: GHOST ARMY's DRAW FIRE: while it is in your Frontline, enemy attacks on your Frontline must target it if able. Concealment 2, was 3.
New: COLLAPSE OF WILL: if you have more ISR than the enemy, they lose 1 Homefront per card on your Mission Track, at most 3.
New, words only: FERRYMAN's EXFIL is now CASEVAC and names a destroyed Capability; HAILSTONE's VOLLEY says "exhausted" in small letters. Both play as before.

Three new cards: HAILSTONE, rockets on trucks, 3 copies, 2 in the opening; PAPER TIGER, 1 copy, whose FALSE TARGETS makes enemy attacks on your face-up cards cost 1 more ISR; FERRYMAN, a light helicopter, 1 copy.
SLEEPERS, now Generation I and cost 2, open in place of WATCHTOWER. RELAY, 2 copies, replaces LONGKNIFE HQ.
Out: WATCHTOWER, SHIELDWALL, LONGKNIFE HQ, WIRETAP, the second AUGUR, and one each of DEAD RECKONING, ELECTRONIC ATTACK, INFORMATION ADVANTAGE and POLTERGEIST. In: a second COLLAPSE OF WILL.

Since the released deck, still in force: THE SILENT costs 6, not 7; POLTERGEIST's INJECT reaches either Mission Track; NAVIGATION WARFARE is now DEAD RECKONING; in: BUSHWHACKER, INFORMATION ADVANTAGE; out: GRAY ZONE, STRATEGIC NARRATIVE, SYSTEMS CASCADE, WAR WEARINESS, VELITES, one PUPPETEER.
DEAD RECKONING and INFORMATION ADVANTAGE print how long they last. TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL may be a Reaction outside your home Base Zone.
No balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The fires deck. It finds, strikes from range, confirms, and strikes again before the enemy can close.
It cannot hold ground: an enemy that reaches its line and stays there beats it.
changes: One STEEL RAIN starts in the Initial Entry beside two JAEGER (it was two STEEL RAIN and one JAEGER). A second VELITES replaces one BLACK SAIL.
TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL joins the deck in place of CONVERGENCE. It may also be played as a Reaction when your Frontline is attacked in Contact outside your home Base Zone.
BLACK FALCON's HYPERSONIC is ATK 5, down from 6.
FIRE SUPPORT on REDLEG and DRUMFIRE now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
